title: Mark safety reminder on departure list
goal: Use color to set the text color of two safety reminders individually.
summary: color determines the text color of the element. Ordinary list items will inherit the text color of the page. After selecting the reminder item, you can set the color for them individually.
tasks: Select the list item that already has the reminder class.
Set the text color of two reminders to #9c3412, and keep the existing colors for the remaining list items.

example.note: The event roster can mark the confirmed registration status in dark green.

hint: If the entire list changes color, check whether the selector selects each li. Reminder items already have a reminder class.
